title: Help Scout alternatives for B2B teams outgrowing email | Pylon
summary: Compare 7 Help Scout alternatives, including Pylon, Front, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, HubSpot Service Hub, and Plain, on channels, AI, and entry price.
body_markdown:
Help Scout is a clean shared inbox, and for a small team answering email it's hard to beat. The trouble starts when your customers move into Slack Connect channels and Microsoft Teams, and every account has five people asking questions. Help Scout's own docs say it plainly: "Slack is not a Help Scout support channel." This guide covers 7 Help Scout alternatives, where each one fits, and what they cost to start.


Quick note on names: Intercom is the help desk, and Fin by Intercom is its AI agent. We use "Intercom" for the help desk and "Fin" for the agent below.


## Why B2B teams look past Help Scout


Your customers aren't only in email. Help Scout covers email, live chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger on paid plans, with phone through integrations. Its Slack integration sends Help Scout notifications into Slack, but you can't create or manage conversations from Slack.


Accounts have many people. Help Scout groups conversations by company on Plus and Pro. If you need SLAs, routing, and health by account across every channel, you'll want a tool built around the account.


AI costs scale with volume. Help Scout's AI agent, Envoy, is an add-on billed per resolution. That's predictable per conversation, and you can set a monthly cap, but cost still grows with volume.


SLA depth is tiered. Standard includes 1 basic SLA policy, Plus includes 2 advanced policies, and Pro is unlimited.


## What to look for in a Help Scout alternative


- **Native Slack and Microsoft Teams channels, not notifications.** Customers should be able to ask in their shared channel and get an answer there.
- **Account context in every reply.** Who the customer is, what they've asked before, what's open with engineering.
- **Agents that investigate, not just answer.** Look for agents that pull from your CRM, issue tracker, and past conversations before a person opens the issue.
- **A pricing model you can plan around.** Know whether AI is billed per resolution, per session, per seat, or from a shared credit pool.
- **A real migration path.** Conversations, customers, companies, and knowledge base articles should all move over.


## The 7 best Help Scout alternatives


### Pylon


**Best for:** B2B teams supporting customers in Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and chat.


Pylon is the agentic support platform built for B2B. Slack Connect, Slack Community, email, the chat widget, Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, and ticket forms are on every plan, and Microsoft Teams and Google Chat are on Advanced and Enterprise. Every conversation becomes an issue in one inbox, tied to the account.


Agents investigate issues before your team opens them, and your team directs the work:


- Support Agent answers customer questions from your content, collects information, gathers internal context, and can resolve issues end to end.
- Assist Agent helps your team investigate issues, draft replies, and take actions using workspace context.
- Slack Agent answers questions and takes action from Slack with the same customer context and permissions as Pylon.
- Automations run on an event or schedule, for example investigating new issues as they arrive and surfacing what they find.
- Skills are reusable instructions that teach agents how your team handles a scenario. Skills are included on every plan.


Pylon also supports four SLA types (first response, next response, follow-up, and resolution) and a read and write MCP server that can send customer replies and post internal notes.


**Proof:** our own support team adopted these agents, and median first response time fell 72%, from 19.4 to 5.3 minutes.


**Pricing:** Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Enterprise is a custom quote. Agentic features (Assist Agent, Support Agent, Slack Agent, and Automations) run on credits, available pay as you go or as a committed plan, and you can top up in Pylon anytime. Pylon doesn't charge per issue. See Pylon pricing.


**Tradeoffs:** there's no free plan, there's a minimum seat count for new customers, and Microsoft Teams needs Advanced. If you only want to add AI on top of your current help desk, Pylon isn't built for that. It replaces the help desk.


**Migrating from Help Scout:**[Pylon's help center has a Help Scout migration guide](https://support.usepylon.com/articles/4400330627-migrating-from-help-scout) . Companies, customers, conversations, teams, users, and knowledge base articles map into Pylon. Migrated conversations arrive closed. Across 300+ migrations from Zendesk, Intercom, and Salesforce, 90% finished in under 2 months.


### Front


**Best for:** email-first teams that want a collaborative shared inbox with more channels.


Front feels familiar if you like Help Scout's inbox, and adds more automation and AI. Professional and Enterprise are omnichannel (email, SMS, social, WhatsApp). Front can read and reply to Slack messages from public and private channels, and connect Microsoft Teams channel posts to an inbox. Copilot assists teammates, and Autopilot is Front's AI agent, sold as an add-on. Starter supports a single channel type.


### Zendesk


**Best for:** large teams that want deep configuration and a big app ecosystem.


Zendesk's Suite plans bring email, messaging, phone, and social into one place, and list messaging apps including WhatsApp and Slack. AI agents come with a set number of included automated resolutions per agent, and you can commit to more. Copilot can be added on Professional and higher plans. It's a lot of platform, which is the point for some teams.


### Freshdesk


**Best for:** teams that want a familiar ticketing tool at a low entry price.


Freshdesk includes ticketing, a shared inbox, a customer portal, and a knowledge base on every paid plan. Freddy AI Agent includes 500 free sessions once per account, with more sold in session packs. Freddy AI Copilot is an add-on on Pro and Enterprise. Freshdesk's Slack app lets agents create tickets from Slack messages and collaborate in notification threads that sync back as private notes.


### Intercom


**Best for:** product-led teams that support customers in-app.


Intercom pairs Messenger live chat with a shared inbox, ticketing, and a help center. Fin bills per outcome, on Intercom or on another help desk. Higher tiers add workflow automation, SLAs, and SSO.


### HubSpot Service Hub


**Best for:** teams that run sales and marketing on HubSpot and want support in the same CRM.


Service Hub's help desk connects chat, email, forms, calling, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger. Customer Agent, HubSpot's AI agent, is on Professional and runs on HubSpot Credits. On Professional and Enterprise you can sync help desk tickets to Slack and update ticket properties there.


More detail in[HubSpot Service Hub alternatives](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/hubspot-service-hub-alternatives) .


### Plain


**Best for:** technical B2B teams that support customers in Slack.


Plain's Foundation plan includes Slack, email, and in-app channels, Linear and Jira integrations, and AI agents on monthly credits. Microsoft Teams, SLAs, and CRM integrations are on Horizon.

## Which Help Scout alternative should you pick?


If most of your support is email and your team is small, Help Scout may still be right. If customers live in Slack or Teams and every issue needs account context, look at Pylon. If you want a collaborative email inbox with AI, look at Front. If you're all-in on HubSpot's CRM, Service Hub keeps support next to your deals.

## FAQ


### What's the best Help Scout alternative for B2B support?


For B2B teams that support customers in Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email, Pylon is built for account-based support with agents. Front fits email-first teams that want a collaborative inbox, and HubSpot Service Hub fits teams already on HubSpot's CRM.


### Does Help Scout support Slack?


Help Scout's Slack integration sends Help Scout notifications into Slack. Help Scout's docs say Slack is not a Help Scout support channel, so you can't create or manage conversations from Slack.


### How is Pylon priced compared with Help Scout?


Pylon Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Enterprise is a custom quote. Agentic features run on credits, and Pylon doesn't charge per issue. Help Scout has a free plan and paid plans from $25 per user per month, with its AI agent billed per resolution.


### Can I migrate from Help Scout to Pylon?


Yes. Pylon's help center has a Help Scout migration guide covering companies, customers, conversations, teams, users, and knowledge base articles. Migrated conversations arrive in a closed state.


### When should I stay on Help Scout?


Stay on Help Scout if your team is small, most conversations are simple email questions, and you don't need Slack or Microsoft Teams as customer channels.
